cited.quote: accords administrative approval for undertaking the Detailed Feasibility Studies by Chennai Metro Rail Limited (CMRL)
decided to sanction a sum of Rs.4,80,00,000/- (Rupees Four Crore and Eighty Lakh only)

rationale: C5 (GO 88, 2022) approves feasibility studies for Thirumangalam-Avadi via Mugappair and Ambattur and Kelambakkam-Kilambakkam via Vandalur; C1 sanctions DPR funds for Koyambedu-Avadi. These are official preparatory steps, but no extract shows the lines being laid, and Tirisulam and Kathipara-Poonamallee are not covered. In progress.

cited.quote: the Government approved the Notification for filling up of the 36 posts of Prosthetic Craftsman
Creation of two posts of Junior Assistants on permanent basis against the surrender of 66 driver posts

rationale: C5 shows an approved GO (dated 31.01.2025) for direct recruitment to fill hospital-sector vacancies, and C4 creates posts. That covers part of filling vacancies. C1 and C2 only enhance or continue contract pay and posts; no extract shows regularisation of contract workers. Evidence is thin, so partial with doubt.

cited.quote: mechanized removal of Prosopis juliflora (locally known as Seemai Karuvelam) in water bodies under the control
removal of Prosopis juliflora (locally known as Seemai Karuvelam) will improve the flow in Channels during monsoon

rationale: Directional promise. C3 and C1 are G.O.(Ms) No.48 dated 14.03.2026, a dedicated order for mechanised removal of Seemai Karuvelam from water bodies, directing Chief Engineers to remove it fully. That is a new dedicated measure on the subject. Aagaya Thamarai is not mentioned, but the promise is directional.

cited.quote: At present 1,353 Ambulances are under operation across the State.
aiming to maintain the fleet strength of 1,353 in 108 Services

rationale: C2, C3 and C4 all report a fleet of 1,353 ambulances, and C4 sanctions only replacement vehicles to maintain that strength. The fleet has not risen to 2000 and no extract shows 6 ambulances per Panchayat Union. C5 adds two donated mini ambulances, which is immaterial. No step toward the stated target.

cited.quote: From 01.04.2023 onwards, Iron, Folic acid and Vitamin B12 rice kernels are blended with regular rice

rationale: Extracts C1 to C3 describe rice supply under the public distribution system, including fortified rice, which comes from the Union allocation and is a nutrition measure. No extract shows an official step to raise the quality of rice supplied. C4 and C5 are crop schemes for farmers. Related activity only.

cited.quote: Additional corpus fund of Rs.10.00 crore will be provided to the Handloom Weavers Cooperative Societies

rationale: The extracts cover interest subsidy, working capital and corpus support to weavers' cooperative societies through existing district central cooperative banks (C1, C4, C5). None shows a dedicated cooperative bank for handloom weavers or a distinct weaver identity card. Only related activity.

cited.quote: TANTRANSCO has stepped into setting up of 765 kV own transmission network mainly for

rationale: C2 and C3 describe general transmission expansion, including a 765 kV network for green energy from the southern parts of the State. No extract shows a special line or scheme for the named districts aimed at cutting wastage. C1 is an old audit report; C4 and C5 are unrelated. Only related activity.

cited.quote: Most of the Fair Price Shops are run by Cooperative Department through registered cooperative

rationale: C3 (policy note dated 2024-01-04) shows fair price shops still run by the Cooperative Department, the Tamil Nadu Civil Supplies Corporation, self-help groups and other societies. C5 only allocates subjects among officers. No official step to bring the shops under a single department.

cited.quote: To encourage youth and entrepreneurs to establish improved silk reeling units and to increase silk production in the State

rationale: Directional promise. C1 and C2 are policy notes describing financial assistance for silk reeling units under existing State Plan and Silk Samagra-2 schemes; this is continuing activity with no new dedicated GO or scheme shown. C4 and C5 concern other textile incentives. Mentions in a policy note only.

cited.quote: From March 2023 onwards, transgender monthly pension has been enhanced from Rs.1000 to Rs.1500
monthly pension amount has been enhanced from Rs.1000 to Rs.1500 under this scheme

rationale: C2 shows the pension for destitute transgender persons at Rs.1,000 in 2021-22. C3 and C1 report it enhanced from Rs.1000 to Rs.1500 from March 2023, with beneficiaries paid in 2023-24 and 2024-25. This matches the promised amount and group.

No extract mentions permission to use land for poultry farms, poultry licensing or a transfer of that authority between the Directorate of Town and Country Planning and Panchayat Unions. C1 and C2 describe general planning functions; C4 and C5 are about unauthorised development rules; C3 is about panchayat sanitation.

cited.quote: enforcement officers inspected 33,504 establishments which includes the raids conducted by the teams formed
138 child labours were rescued and rehabilitated
203 Special Training Centers are functioning in the 15 NCLP project districts

rationale: C1, C2 and C3 show enforcement of the child labour Act: inspections, rescues, convictions and a task force. C2 also notes special training centres for rescued children, but these are a Union-funded project in 15 districts. No dedicated new State education measure is shown, and the enforcement dates are mostly periods, so partial with doubt.

cited.quote: Granting Lumpsum amount for acquiring additional educational qualification to the State Government Employees

rationale: C3 (G.O. 95, 2023-10-26) gives a one-time lumpsum for State Government servants acquiring higher qualifications, but it is a general order for all employees and never mentions teachers; it also restricts the incentive. A broader scheme is not credited for teachers. C1, C2, C4, C5 do not address it.

cited.quote: Currently, 40% of households have access to house service connections.

rationale: C1, C2 and C3 describe water supply projects and the goal of tap connections for all households in town panchayats, with only 40-42% coverage. No extract shows an order or scheme guaranteeing a connection within 15 days of request. C5 sets timelines for business approvals, not drinking water connections.

cited.quote: bring out institutionally qualified medical practitioners to provide quality health care to the public

rationale: The extracts (C1 to C5) cover government colleges, seats, equipment and a drug testing laboratory for Indian medicine and homoeopathy. None shows an official step to give government recognition to professionally qualified practitioners (such as registration or recognition orders), and acupuncture is not mentioned. Related activity only.

cited.quote: The following categories of landless people are eligible for getting benefits under AHP.

rationale: C1 and C2 are guidelines and an Aadhaar order for housing under the Affordable Housing in Partnership scheme, with general eligibility categories. No extract mentions identity cards issued in the earlier DMK period or priority allotment for their holders. C3 to C5 concern other groups. Related activity only.

cited.quote: This Government will also urge the Union Government to make necessary laws and amendments to grant Indian citizenship

rationale: C3 is a statement of intent to urge the Union Government on citizenship for Sri Lankan Tamil refugees; it does not mention the 2019 Citizenship Act amendment, and no resolution or letter is shown. C2 and C4 report an advisory committee, and C1 its proposals, but these are State deliberations, not formal advocacy to the Union.

No extract is about the validity period of Teacher Eligibility Test certificates or any legal recommendation on it. C5 restructures the Teachers Recruitment Board, which is a neighbouring subject; C1, C3, C4 concern revenue certificates and audit; C2 is a wind power policy.

The promise does not name the institute, and no extract shows a step to revive and upgrade an institute. C1 to C5 are establishment orders reviving or continuing individual posts (for example at the National Centre of Ageing), which is not reviving an institution.

cited.quote: In G.O.(Ms)No.327, Home (Prison-1) Department, Dated 12.08.2021, two candidates were appointed as Psychologist by Direct Recruitment
From the year 2021 to till date, 255 persons were appointed in various posts

rationale: The promise is vague, with no number or department. C2 shows a GO dated 12.08.2021 appointing candidates by direct recruitment, and C1 reports 255 appointments since 2021 with more selected. C4 and C5 approve recruitment notifications. Additional appointments were made, but scope is uncertain.
